The Agility master cape is the cape awarded for achieving True skill mastery by reaching virtual level 120 (equivalent to 104,273,167 experience) Agility.
The cape is sold by Cap'n Izzy No-Beard in Brimhaven and by Elen Anterth in the Max Guild for 120,000 coins.

The blood-dyed augmented off-hand drygore mace is a level 90 Melee off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a off-hand drygore mace (blood), or by using blood dye on an augmented off-hand drygore mace.

The catalytic staff, the Tier 42 staff in Dungeoneering, can be found in the dungeons under Daemonheim, requiring 40 Magic to wield.

Free players can obtain this as a drop from the Unholy cursebearer boss, by receiving it as a starting item when entering a floor, or by imbuing a spinebeam staff or better on a runecrafting altar (minimum 48 Fletching / 50 Runecrafting).

The Fayre Crystal Ball is a cosmetic override for magic off-hand weapons unlocked by activating a crystal ball token, which can be purchased for 100 Fayre prize tickets from Rixie or found when participating in activities during the Spring Fayre.

This key piece is generally regarded as the hardest to obtain, as all monsters that drop it have a combat level of over 90.

Full slayer helmet (green).x: The green full slayer helmet is a level 20 slayer helmet with bonuses equivalent to a hybrid iron full helm. It is made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which must be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.

Imps are not a good way to train Hunter as they cannot be released until 2 items/stacks have been banked, making this a fairly slow method of training. A way to speed training up is to bank full imp boxes with other imp boxes while catching them, this frees up one imp box for every three imps caught. Another method to speed up training is by using a snow globe to create snowballs, and then using the imps to bank the snowballs. This however leaves many snowballs in the bank which take time to destroy. Other similar methods involve fletching bolts and using an albino rat and scrolls to create cheese.

Players who wish to kill catablepon to obtain their piece of the sceptre should know that it takes a while and that supplies to kill about 50-100 catablepon or so should be taken if the player wishes to obtain it in one trip. Keep in mind while preparing that the most devastating thing about them is not the damage they inflict, but the weakening spell they use, which drains strength by up to 15% of their opponent's maximum level. It would be advisable to bring a supply of strength potions to boost up your Strength and help counter-act this spell.
Wearing any part of the Varrock armour will slightly increase its drop rate.
sc: The top of sceptre is a piece of the skull sceptre that is dropped by catablepon in the third level of the Stronghold of Security, which is the dungeon beneath Barbarian Village, to the west of Varrock and east of the dwarven mines.
